main_text.head: De Juramenti Obligatione
main_text.l: I3. Juramentum est sua natura obligato-rium.
I4. Obligationis in Assertorio & Promisso-rio discrimen.
main_text.head: SECT. I.
main_text.p: DE qua expeditius, & vestro majori cum fructu dicturum me arbitror, si in ipso statim vestibulo futurae tractationis generalem quasi typum & σκιαγραφίαν[?] vobis ante oculos posuero. Sic enim & vobis melius constabit instituti mei ratio; & ego certas orationi meae metas figam: ut aut intra debitos fines usque se contineat; aut si quando forte extra oleas paululum procurrerit, non tamen ita laxe evagetur, quin ut possit mature & cito in ordinem cogi, & ad lineas revocari. Tribus itaque capitibus rem totam absolvam. Primum, ut qua de re agitur clarius intelligatur, ostendam quid sit Juramentum[?] in genere, quid in specie

page.notes: The numerals in the list are printed in old form (IO, II, I2, I3, I4) and are copied as printed. The long s in the italic words is read as a plain s. The dash at the line end of items 13 and 14 is a printed hyphen, kept in the word. The Greek word σκιαγραφίαν and the italic word "Juramentum" are not fully clear at this scan quality and are marked [?].
